data.llm_justification: The combination of a catastrophic reply rate (14.4%) with a simultaneous -55.6% BL velocity collapse and zero hotlead activity creates a compounding disengagement signal that the rule-based model underweights at 39 — the seller is both receiving far fewer leads AND ignoring the ones they do get, while the TYPE_A sudden cliff trajectory suggests this deterioration is acute and accelerating rather than gradual. The high clickstream (2425) and active days (24) indicate platform presence but deliberate non-conversion behavior, which is a stronger churn precursor than passive absence.
llm_interactions: Low reply rate (14.4%) × BL velocity collapse (-55.6%) — simultaneous demand-side shrinkage and supply-side non-response amplifies churn risk beyond either signal alone
Zero hotleads × 278 BLs received — high enquiry volume with no hotlead conversion suggests severe quality mismatch or deliberate disengagement from conversion funnel
High clickstream (2425) + 24 active days × zero reply engagement — seller is browsing but not acting, indicating platform fatigue or intent to leave rather than technical absence

TYPE_A sudden cliff × CQS 89 — a high catalog quality score alongside sudden behavioral collapse suggests an external trigger (competitor, pricing, business issue) rather than gradual dissatisfaction, making recovery window narrow
PNS answer rate 150% (anomalous) × 14.4% BL reply rate — inconsistency between phone responsiveness and BL reply behavior may indicate selective disengagement or data artifact worth flagging

data.cta: Reply YES for a quick setup call

script_parts.opening: Namaste Ravi Nandan ji, main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — Geestone Tyre ke baare mein baat karni thi. Ji, aapka account kaafi strong raha hai — 14 saal se upar ho gaye hain aapke saath — lekin last 2 mahine mein aapki Business Leads mein 55.6% ki sudden drop aayi hai, toh seedha aapse samajhna chahta tha ki kya ho raha hai.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, ek cheez puchna tha — pehle aap regularly platform use kar rahe the, phir achanak engagement ruk gayi; kya koi specific reason tha — jaise buyers ki quality theek nahi lagi, ya aapki team ki taraf se koi operational change hua, ya simply time nahi mil raha tha replies dene ka?
script_parts.value_demo: Dekho ji, aapka CQS score 89 hai jo bahut achha hai — matlab aapka catalog aur profile strong hai — aur aapka PNS success 150% pe hai, toh platform pe aapki visibility bani hui hai; problem sirf yeh hai ki last 30 din mein reply rate 14.4% pe aa gayi hai, aur jab buyer ko reply nahi milta toh wo next seller ke paas chala jaata hai — yeh directly aapke leads ko affect kar raha hai.
script_parts.action: Chaliye abhi ek kaam karte hain — main aapke saath live aapka Leads section open karta hoon aur jo last 30 din ke unanswered leads hain unhe dekhte hain; agar aap 5 minute de sako toh hum ek quick reply template bhi set kar dete hain taaki future mein koi lead miss na ho.
script_parts.close: Ravi Nandan ji, aaj ke liye bas itna kaafi hai — agle 7 din mein agar aap sirf un pending leads ko reply kar do, toh hum next call mein actual improvement track karenge; koi pressure nahi, bas ek chhota sa step — theek hai?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello Ravi Nandan ji, this is IndiaMART calling regarding your Geestone Tyre account. You've been with us for over 14 years, which is remarkable — but in the last 2 months, your Business Lead velocity has dropped by 55.6%, so I wanted to speak with you directly to understand what's happening.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Bhai, I wanted to ask — you were very active on the platform earlier, and then engagement dropped quite suddenly; was there a specific reason — like the buyer quality wasn't satisfactory, or there was some operational change on your end, or simply not enough time to reply to leads?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's what the data shows, ji — your CQS score is 89, which means your catalog and profile are in great shape, and your PNS success is at 150%, so your visibility on the platform is intact; the only issue is that your reply rate in the last 30 days has fallen to 14.4%, and when a buyer doesn't get a response, they simply move to the next seller — that's directly causing your lead drop.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one thing right now on this call — I'll walk you through your Leads section and we'll look at the unanswered leads from the last 30 days together; if you can give me 5 minutes, we can also set up a quick reply template so no future lead gets missed.
script_parts_en.close: Ravi Nandan ji, that's all for today — if over the next 7 days you can respond to those pending leads, we'll track the actual improvement on our next call together; no pressure at all, just one small step — does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
